ModMetaData.name: Colony Doctor
ModMetaData.author: Tw1stedGene
ModMetaData.description:
Why isn't work getting done? Colony Doctor tells you.
Colony Doctor watches your bills and construction sites over time and explains, in plain language, what has been holding each one up. A new Bottlenecks tab lists everything that's stalled, worst first, over the last hour, day or quadrum, with a timeline, a breakdown of the reasons and Jump to.
What it can tell you: - Bench problem: no power, out of fuel, broken down, the work spot is blocked, or no one can reach the bench. - No eligible worker: nobody has the work type enabled or is capable of it, the bill's worker restriction or skill range excludes everyone, or an allowed area keeps them away. - Blocked: a plant, item, building or rock is in the way of a construction site. - Materials missing: none on the map, excluded by the bill's filter, forbidden, outside the ingredient radius, reserved or unreachable. - Waiting for a worker: nothing blocks it, but nobody has started yet.
"Bills stalled" and "Construction stalled" alerts tell you when something has been stuck for at least half of the last day.
Read-only: Colony Doctor never changes your colony, and nothing is written to your save, so you can add or remove it mid-game. Requires Harmony.
